title: Chimerify Core
description: Core library required for Chimerify and its addons.
body:
# **Chimerify Core**

Chimerify Core is a [required library for Chimerify](https://modrinth.com/mod/chimerify) and its addons. It does not add standalone gameplay content.

It provides the common internal systems required by Chimerify and supported addons, including shared runtime logic, part-processing pipelines, compatibility layers, and technical framework code used to power creature integrations and mutation systems.

## Important

- This is a library/dependency mod
- It is not meant to be installed for standalone gameplay
- Install it only if a Chimerify mod or addon requires it

## Used by

- Chimerify
- Chimerify addons

## Notes

- This project is under active development
- Internal systems may change over time
